Work on the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project has been almost at a standstill since 2022 because of protests by local residents, who say the dam will not only destroy their ancestral land and livelihood, but also the ecology of the region. Friday’s incident, where protesters torched the NHPC office in Pasighat, has put a fresh cloud of uncertainty over the project’s future. Moushumi das Gupta reports.
